baseline.text: UI and ME will play with play-dough to prototype the look and feel of the design and the user interface.
We will not include D_V_D_ (DVD) features in the remote design.
There is uncertainty about whether to include a screen, given ambiguous use and the potential cost, with debate on its necessity versus a wheel-based control.
We will pursue a fashion electronics approach with a fruit-and-vegetable motif, including the decision on whether the motif is printed or the remote resembles a fruit.
The menu system should reside inside the TV, not inside the remote.
For now we will do two prototypes of the product.
The group proposed to use batteries as the energy source for the product, with the batteries placed right under the plastic case.
The group proposed promoting the banana variant.
The company colours will be silver and yellow, and the logo should be placed somewhere on the product.

gold.text: The Project Manager reviewed the minutes from the previous meeting.
The Industrial Designer gave her presentation on components and discussed which would have to be custom-made and which were standard.
She also discussed the various materials and chips available.
The Marketing Expert presented current trends in the market and in fashion.
She discussed the current fruits and vegetables trend and the trend toward softer, spongier materials.
The User Interface Designer discussed the look of the remote with the group.
They discussed including a touch-based graphical user interface but noted that it was unnecessary and costly.
They discussed using the menu function on the television instead.
The group discussed how the menu function would be programmed.
The group then talked about the casing of the device, and decided that there would be a changeable outer casing.
They discussed including fruit colors in addition to the company colors.
Some part of the casing will be made of a spongy material.
The group also discussed energy source options and chips.
The Project Manager instructed the User Interface Designer and the Industrial Designer to construct the prototype and the Marketing Expert to work on the prototype evaluation.
The User Interface Designer and the Industrial Designer will build the prototype, working on the user interface and the look and feel.
The Marketing Expert will prepare a prototype evaluation.
The remote will feature a spongy material.
The fruits and vegetables trend will be incorporated into the design by including fruit colors along with the company colors.
The remote will feature a changeable outer casing.
The group wanted to include a changeable outer casing but could not decide whether the spongy or the hard plastic component should be the removable casing.
There was a lack of information on the cost of several components.
The remote will not have its own screen; menus will be shown on the television.
The remote will not support DVD players.
